## Rejected\n### OOS_4: BASH_COMPAT smoke is not real Bash 3.2 coverage\n- **OOS_4**: cursor-specialist; exonerated (YES=1 NO=0 EXON=2) — concern noted; make lint-bash32 is the authoritative portability gate

## Rejected\n### OOS_5: Design edits route through multiple costly direct targets\n- **OOS_5**: cursor-specialist-structure; exonerated (YES=0 NO=0 EXON=3) — performance concern noted; not a correctness issue

## Rejected\n### OOS_6: Step marker lines with same-line directives are ignored\n- **OOS_6**: cursor-specialist-correctness; exonerated (YES=0 NO=0 EXON=3) — no current SKILL.md uses directives on the same line as step markers
